cues.text: Read what visitors send from the website, reply, and turn a promising message into a lead.
Every message sent from the website lands in the Inbox.
New messages are on top. Leasing enquiries and general contact messages have their own tabs.
A leasing enquiry opens a lead by itself, so no brand is ever lost. The badge takes you to it.
Open a contact message to read it in full.
You see the message, who sent it, how to reach them and the language they wrote in.
Reply by email opens your mail with the address and subject ready.
When it needs nothing more, archive it to keep the inbox clean.
This one sounds like a future tenant, so choose Convert to lead.
The lead is created with their name and email, and a first call is planned for today. Give it an owner, and the deal has started.
